content:
Jamie Chen: quick sync - we need a compact decision matrix for fallback ordering when a requested model variant isn't available. specifically: tokenizer parity, context length, and tool-calling support. who wants to take a stab at priorities?

Sofia Patel: i'm +1 for a priority list. my instinct: 1) tokenizer parity (must match tokens) 2) tool-calling parity 3) context length 4) perf/cost. tokenizer mismatch can break tool-calls too.

Ryan O'Neill: +1 but nuance: if tokenizer mismatch is only small (<=8 tokens/utterance diff) we can accept if other parity checks pass. need a heuristic threshold.

Lydia Gomez: product POV: customers care about function-calling working reliably. they'd prefer slightly shorter context than broken tool output. so tool-calling parity might be higher priority for some enterprise customers. can we make it tier-configurable?

Jamie Chen: yes, tier-configurable sounds right. default ordering matches Sofia, but enterprise tiers can flip tool-calling above tokenizer. we should capture that in the routing policy + console UI.

Sasha K.: for console UX: propose a compact summary: "Fallback precedence: Tokenizer -> ToolCall -> Context -> Perf" with an inline toggle for "Override by tier" and an explanation tooltip.

Mel Rivera: on telemetry: we must record exact reason code for any fallback (e.g., TOKENIZER_MISMATCH, TOOL_CALL_INCOMPAT, CONTEXT_TRUNCATE, CAPACITY) so we can query regressions. also capture token delta and whether KV cache was preserved.

Ryan O'Neill: agree. Also need to log a small compatibility matrix at decision time. something like: ```
// example matrix snapshot
variant_requested: redwood-v2-qa
variant_candidate: redwood-v2-qa-8bit
tokenizer_parity: false
token_delta: 12
tool_call_supported: true
context_max_candidate: 8192
context_max_requested: 16384
fallback_reason: TOKENIZER_MISMATCH
```

Sofia Patel: small ask - can we compute tokenizer delta cheaply? we can sample a small prompt window (first 128 tokens) and compare. should be fast enough for routing decision. if sampling shows large delta, early fail.

Jamie Chen: performance budget: router decision should be <= 2ms median. sampling 128 tokens on request path ok only if we cache model tokenizer fingerprints. precompute deltas between pairs of variants and keep in a matrix good.

Lydia Gomez: that precomputed matrix needs to be surfaced in the console (read-only) and available via API so customers can see what will happen for their pinned variants. also add a "simulate fallback" button for rollouts.

Sasha K.: UX note: show a compact table per model family: column headers: variant, tokenizer_id, max_context, tool_call=Y/N. row highlight when parity gaps exist. also link to reasons logs.

Mel Rivera: edge case: tool-calling parity can be partial (different function signatures). we should treat mismatch as TOOL_CALL_INCOMPAT if any difference >0. maybe add severity levels: TOOL_CALL_MINOR, TOOL_CALL_MAJOR.

Ryan O'Neill: +1 on severity. For tokenizers, also record whether mismatch affects token-to-char alignment (important for span-based tool-calls). field: token_alignment_risk = LOW/MED/HIGH.

Jamie Chen: ok action items: 1) eng-runtime (Sofia + Ryan) compute and export precomputed compatibility matrix for deployed variants; store as small key-value in config service. 2) eng-platform (me + Mel) record and standardize fallback reason codes and telemetry schema. 3) devex (Sasha) wire a console card + simulate button. 4) product (Lydia) prepare tier override spec and help text. target PRs by end of sprint.

Sasha K.: will sketch UI mock tomorrow and add copy for tooltips.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: router-config-service v2.7 -> canary in prod at 2024-10-12T03:00:00Z (no changes yet) :rocket:

Lydia Gomez: one more ask: add a "soft-fallback" mode where we route but attach an annotation to the response indicating fallback happened (for logs and client-side handling). useful for gradual rollouts.

Sofia Patel: soft-fallback ok, as long as we keep tokenization ratio in header: `X-Fallback-Token-Ratio: 0.92` and `X-Fallback-Reason: TOKENIZER_MISMATCH`.

Jamie Chen: agreed. I'll create the RFC doc and prototype the telemetry fields tonight. thanks everyone.
